Hsp70-Hom M493T is associated with increased discrimination between abacavir-hypersensitive cases and tolerant controls when added to HLA-B*57:01 testing as compared to HLA-B*57:01 testing alone.
Hsp70-Hom M493T is associated with altered Hsp70-Hom protein sequence resulting in methionine to threonine substitution at residue 493 as compared to Hsp70-Hom 493M.
Hsp70-Hom M493T is associated with altered predicted substrate binding in the peptide-binding domain of Hsp70-Hom as compared to Hsp70-Hom 493M.
Hsp70-Hom M493T is associated with increased linkage disequilibrium with HLA-B*57:01 in the abacavir-exposed cohort as compared to not carrying Hsp70-Hom M493T.
Hsp70-Hom M493T is associated with increased likelihood of absent clinical tolerance to abacavir when present with HLA-B*57:01 as compared to not carrying both markers.
